metaDescription: Instinct is a Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric mod that makes the animals you tame, breed, and keep worth the keeping: pets that avoid lava and grow veteran with age, livestock bloodlines, herd flocking, a feeding trough, a command whistle, and downed-pet revival.
ogDescription: A husbandry overhaul for Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric. Self-preserving pets, veterancy, quality genetics, flocking herds, the feeding trough, the command whistle, and downed-pet revival.

hero.sub: Instinct makes the animals you tame, breed, and keep worth the keeping — pets that act like they want to live, bloodlines worth tending, herds that follow like herds. Everything works on the animals already in your world.

sections.title: In Development
sections.lede: Instinct is fully designed and specced — implementation is underway. Nothing is released yet; everything below describes the design.

items.title: Pets That Look Before They Leap
html: Tamed wolves, cats, and parrots path around lava and cacti, keep a 4-block berth from ignited creepers, and refuse to teleport to you mid-fall. The pet you tame in week one can still be alive on day one hundred.

items.title: Veteran Pets
html: Every pet quietly counts the days it survives with you. At 10, 30, and 60 days it gains a rank — up to +3 hearts and +3 attack damage. An old wolf is meaningfully stronger than a fresh tame.

items.title: Quality Genetics
html: Well-fed, uncrowded breeding raises a bloodline: ordinary, sturdy, prime. A prime cow drops 2 extra beef and 1 extra leather — three tended generations beat three hundred crammed ones.

items.title: A Working Farm
html: A feeding trough that breeds the herd while you're in the mines, a copper whistle that commands the whole pack at once, and a downed state that turns a pet's death into a rescue.

blocks.html: Also in the design: herds that flock 15% faster behind held food with 2-block spacing — swimming rivers in formation while a following pet rides your boat's spare seat — and automatic coverage for modded animals: a tameable otter is a pet, a breedable critter is livestock. Full feature list →

sections.title: Part of Concord
sections.lede: Instinct is a member of Concord — a modular collection of system overhauls. Install any, combine all: every mod stands entirely on its own, and siblings light up together without ever being required.
